steps.content: [First, within the main testing site]

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Mmm... Thanks for the treat.
Synex swallows the crystal torn from the monster's chest. Under the group's relentless assault, the cocoon-spawned creature staggers, then collapses, its body crumbling into dust.
With a slow, deliberate flick of her tongue, Synex licks her fingertips, savoring the remnants of her feast. Her gaze snaps upward, but the figure behind the barrier is long gone.

Meanwhile, the masked man sprints through the ruins, debris scattering in his wake. The experiment failed, but the plan isn't lost yet. If he can just reach Fraser in time, the data he carries might still turn the tide.
But...
A shadow shifts. A figure steps into his path, cutting off his escape.
[First, within the main testing site]
After delivering the final blow, Hella can't help but cheer triumphantly.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Yaaay—huh?!
The entire chamber shudders violently. The research facility, already weakened by the earlier explosions, groans under the strain, its underground section on the brink of total collapse.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Crap, this place's coming down!
Hella's gaze snaps upward. The shattered skylight from her last escape is still there, but this time, Synex isn't here to throw her through it. How are they supposed to get out now?
Before she can scramble for a solution, a grinning, sinister voice cuts through the chaos behind her.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Now that I think about it... Hella was the only one here last time. Our dear little Legion girl still hasn't felt the thrill of being thrown through the air, has she?

Then, a deafening roar echoes from the distance. Something massive barrels toward them, shaking the ground. Hella and Horo barely have time to turn before they're yanked off their feet, collars seized in an iron grip.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh—?! Wait, what the hell are you doing this time—?!

A tidal wave of alchemic beasts surges forward, their bodies merging, limbs weaving together in a grotesque yet seamless dance. They form a living pathway—part staircase, part writhing wave—bridging the crumbling floor to the opening above.

Their movements are terrifyingly precise, as if this escape has been rehearsed a thousand times before. Layer upon layer of shifting, interlocking bodies propel the three upward, just as the world beneath them gives way.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Get ready...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: We're taking off!
[CG - Alchemic Beast Parade]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ahhhhh—!
The high-altitude wind howls, slamming against their faces with enough force to make their eardrums roar. Hella grits her teeth and forces her eyes open.

Behind them, the explosions and collapsing structures fade into the distance as the escapees surge forward, a living tide weaving through ruins and flickering firelight. Their voices rise in long, wild calls, half communication, half exhilaration, echoing into the chaos.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I-I'm going to fall!
At Hella's side, Horo staggers, fighting to keep her footing in the relentless rush, while Synex...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Hahahahahahaha!
The gloomy sky tears open, revealing a burst of light that bathes Synex and the endless stream of creatures surging behind her.
At the crest of the wave, she rides, charging toward freedom.
[Scene Transition: Research Institute Exterior, Damaged]

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: They're back—!
The alchemic beasts disperse, depositing Hella and the Legion members onto the ground, only for them to be swept up again as the refugees celebrate their victory, tossing them high into the air.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Aaaah—! Wait, hold on—! Grab me tight—Don't let go—!
Synex doubles over laughing, clutching her stomach. But then, from the edge of the crowd, a figure catches her eye.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Ooh?
His white coat, once pristine, is now smudged with dirt and the unmistakable marks of gunpowder.

Their eyes lock for a long moment. Then, without a word, he flicks something toward her. Synex catches it midair: a shard of Aurum Secretum. With a barely perceptible nod, he turns and vanishes into the crowd.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: You stubborn little thing.
Synex shakes off the moment and turns to leave, only to feel a tug on her tail. Spinning around, she finds Hella clutching to the tip of it.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Almost let you slip away again! We said we'd settle this for good! You've screwed me over way too many times. This isn't something you can brush off with just a few coins—eek!
Still clutching the tip of Synex's tail, Hella barely has time to register the tight grip around her waist before it coils around her, yanking her off her feet and into the air.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Hmm... what an interesting mess. And here I thought I was finally free—just wrapped up my last "job," ready to go play explorer...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Let's see... what should I do with you?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Oh, how about I just... take you away with me?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What?! HELP! Some creep's kidnapping a child here! Put me down, you jerk! HORO—Horo, help me!
A quick glance to the side confirms that Horo—the mighty Legion leader—is in no shape to help. She clutches her stomach, still pale and unsteady from their recent wild ride.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: My, my, what a fiery little thing! And here you were so adorable just moments ago, crying my name.
In response to such nonsense, Hella retaliates by making a face at her.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Well, that's that. Scores settled, asses kicked—everyone got what they deserved. Time for the little ones to scamper home for dinner... and for me to hit the road.
With a quick flick of her tail, the woman drops Hella to the ground.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: As for you and me...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: We'll talk about it when you catch me someday!
Hella stumbles down the staircase formed by the alchemic beasts, limbs flailing. By the time she scrambles to her feet, Synex and her troop of creatures are already striding away.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey—! Y-you don't just run away, you bastard!!!
Hands on her hips, Hella fumes, but a reluctant smile betrays her. Shaking her fist at the departing figure, she declares her officially wanted.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What a lunatic... hmph...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You're SO dead next time! When I come back, I'm gonna kick your ass so hard you won't sit for a week!
Synex doesn't look back. With a loud, hearty laugh, she waves farewell, her silhouette soon swallowed by the surging tide of alchemic beasts and swirling dust.
[Background - WhiteSands at Sunset]
Somewhere in the farlands. The Legion has "borrowed" a sand ship from the research institute and is now speeding through the dunes.

Though the conspiracy has been thwarted, Fraser is no longer safe for the wanted group. With no other options, they board the stolen sandship and set course for DisCity, bracing for the long journey back home.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Whistle~

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Someone's really excited to go home, huh?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Behold! The one and only superhero who crushed Fraser and wrecked the Aurum Secretum Institute—the strongest Sinner ever, Hella! That's me!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Once we're back at MBCC, even ${PlayerName}'s gonna have to show me some respect—not a single excuse this time! Because I took out one more Black Ring than he did!
steps.female_content: Once we're back at MBCC, even ${PlayerName}'s gonna have to show me some respect—not a single excuse this time! Because I took out one more Black Ring than she did!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: And I've got every last victory written down in my diary, black and white, no arguing! Ha! This time, ${PlayerName} won't have any excuse to stiff me on my allowance!
As Hella boasts with her usual swagger, Horo can't help but crack a smile.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: And the rest? Did you achieve what you set out to do?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...When I first left Syndicate, all I cared about was getting stronger. But if I'm being honest? I had no clue what that actually meant or how to do it.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ugh, I was such a loudmouth back then, running my mouth about becoming some super badass. Pretty embarrassing, huh?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Now I'm still... not that strong. But there are so many people out there who've got it worse. Even if I'm not some powerhouse, I wanna help however I can.
She may still be as weak as before, but this journey has taught her things far more precious than mere strength: the art of deception, the courage to sacrifice, and... the weight of trust.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: And that's good enough for me.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Anyway! Let's get home already! It's been so long. They're probably losing their minds missing me!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We've got loads of time ahead of us for more crazy adventures! Horo, you better not leave me behind next time—promise! No take-backs or you're a total loser!

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Alright, it's a promise.
Hella leans out the window, savoring the evening breeze on their journey home.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Too bad the communicator's busted. Can't even tell Hypa the good news... And who knows where that blue-haired weirdo Saffar wandered off to...
Hella leans against the window, watching the sun bleed into the horizon. Then, she goes completely still. The silence stretches too long. Horo glances up, brow furrowing.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ...Hella?
[Cut to Multiple Reaction Shots with Changing Backgrounds. Korryn's Perspective]
On the outskirts of DisCity, a woman in a cowboy hat raises her glass in a toast, laughing with her companions as they tally their spoils.
But then, she freezes. Her gaze snaps up, sharp and sober, as if something in the depths of WhiteSands has called to her.
Meanwhile, the blonde girl speeds toward a distant point, her foot nearly pressing the accelerator through the floor. Yet no matter how fast she drives, the gap refuses to close.
The beast horde surges forward, an unstoppable tide, until the figure standing at its peak suddenly lifts her head. The Aurum Secretum within her burns, resonating with something far away.
[Return to Hella and Horo's Perspective]
The Furor beads hanging from Hella's body have silently shattered, unnoticed. But there's no time to gather the fragments. Her gaze locks on the horizon—
Dark clouds churn over the area where Furor was. At the heart of WhiteSands, atop a lone hill, the sun is nearly swallowed by a second black disk—an eclipse of unnatural darkness.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: That's... Wait...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Don't tell me the real <color=#fb9259>inheritance</color> is...?!
[Fade out for several seconds, then Background - Refugee Camp]

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: ...? Saffar?

Thani returns to the refugee camp after the battle. The tents now stand empty. Every soul has fled but one. Saffar stands at the camp's edge, his fist clenched around some object. His eyes track the retreating tide of alchemic beasts as they vanish into the horizon.
After a moment, he turns his gaze back, his voice remarkably calm.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: It's nothing. I just wanted to come back for one last look.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: I still have some matters to attend to. I need to go now.
The young man turns his head, a faint smile crossing his face.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: Goodbye, Thani.
